retrieve_memory_data: retrieve the current global memory data including user context, history, and facts via GET /api/memory
create_memory_fact: create a single memory fact with content, category, and confidence score via POST /api/memory/facts
delete_memory_fact: delete a single memory fact by its fact id via DELETE /api/memory/facts/{fact_id}
patch_memory_fact: partially update a memory fact by its fact id while preserving omitted fields via PATCH /api/memory/facts/{fact_id}
get_memory_status: retrieve both memory configuration and current data in a single request via GET /api/memory/status
